ios.desc:
Meet Boko: a tiny pixel pet that lives on your iPhone, in the Dynamic Island, on your Lock Screen and in your widgets.

Adopt a cat or a dog, or turn a photo of your own pet into a pixel Boko. Feed it, play with it, and take it on focus quests while you study or work.

FOCUS QUESTS
• Start a timer from 5 to 120 minutes and your pet sets off on an adventure
• Add tasks and tick them off as you go
• It comes back with XP, moons and sometimes a new hat
• The countdown waits in the Dynamic Island and on your Lock Screen, so you don't need to unlock your phone

YOUR PET, YOUR WAY
• 36 pets to adopt: cats, dogs and more (some need Premium)
• Turn a photo of your real pet into a Boko (Premium or Pet Tokens)
• 54 hats to try on and wear
• 30 worlds to call home and 112 decorations to place

DAILY CARE
• Feed, pat and play: every tap gets a reaction
• Hunger and happiness drop over time, even while you're away
• 12 mini-games, including a daily puzzle
• Good Morning and Goodnight rituals and 60+ achievements

ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island: your pet walks along the top of your screen
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for needs, quests, friends and streaks
• Feed or start a quest right from a widget

BETTER WITH FRIENDS
• Invite friends and see their pets on your Friend Tree
• Send snacks and gifts
• Race each other's scores in the mini-games

MADE WITH CARE
• No ads. Ever.
• 21 languages
• Your pets are backed up to your account

Boko Premium unlocks every world, the exotic pets, Premium hats and decorations, and monthly Pet Tokens for custom pets.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://boko.live/terms
Privacy Policy: https://boko.live/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a Tamagotchi app that lets you add your real-life pets

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I am a student dev, shipping fun stuff in my free time.

This month, I wasn’t sure what to pick up next, but the answer kind of slapped me in the face.

My gf got a new iPhone with a dynamic island. One of the first apps she installed was some sort of game.

Me: “What’s that?”

She: “It’s a Tamagotchi for the dynamic island. Look, it moves!”

Me: “A moving what?!”

After looking deeper into it, the idea was pretty cool, but everything was behind a paywall. And… "no cat variety".

So here it is - Boko, a pet that’s always with you as a live activity. But instead of random pets, you can upload your IRL pet and have it there.

Play with it, feed it, and keep an eye on your daily movement and sleep, since that affects your pet! Let it meet your friends’ pets, and make sure it doesn’t run away if you neglect it.

Search "Boko Pet" in the App Store (sorry Android!)

Enjoy!
P.S. Works without the dynamic island, too!
